title: Nightcord at 25:00 Chapter1 Episode7 Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Where am I? It's so white, and there's nothing here...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's so quiet and cold, too. What is this place?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: For some reason, I feel like I've been here before.
Hey! Is anybody there?!
If anybody can hear me, say something!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That voice sounds familiar...
There's nobody here. Doesn't this kind of feel like one of those stories where you get isekai'd?
Amia, how can you make such carefree jokes at a time like this?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hello?
Whoa! Wh-Who's there?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're Enanan and Amia, aren't you?
What? Oh, I know that voice!
K?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah.
So you're here too?! Phew... I'm a little relieved.

Hey, what's with that reaction?
You didn't seem nearly as happy to see me!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'd like to confirm something.
How did you two get here?
No idea. As soon as I clicked on that “Untitled” file to play it, my computer monitor started glowing. I was like, “I can't see!” Then when I opened my eyes, I was here.
Same here.
If only I had my phone with me. Then I could at least check the GPS. I could probably get some good viral pics here, too.
Now who's the one being carefree?
How exactly are we supposed to get home? And where exactly are we, anyway?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're right. We should find a way home as soon as possible.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Let's try checking out the surrounding area.
We've been walking for a while now, but there's nothing here. I don't even see any people.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I get the feeling our sense of time is off in this place. ...I don't think it's even been an hour yet.
What's the deal? I don't want to be stuck in this creepy place!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Really? I actually don't think it's all that bad.

Isn't this definitely kind of bad?
There's nothing and nobody here except us.
Definitely not what I'd pictured for the first time we meet in person.
I figured we'd go to a restaurant or a cafe or something and be all like “What's your real name?” and “Yay, let me tell you!” and stuff.
Speaking about our real names, K is short for Kanade, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah, but how did you know?
Well, it says “kanade” in your email address, so I figured it must be your name.
Great job hiding it...not! That's just like you, K!
In that case, I'll call you Kanade whenever we meet up in the real world. You can call me Mizuki♪
Aren't you getting ahead of yourself?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Why don't we all call each other by our actual names, then? My full name is Mizuki Akiyama, by the way. Nice to finally meet you, Kanade♪ What's yours, Enanan?
What? Oh, m-my name is Ena Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Alright. So Mizuki and Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: T-This is all kind of sudden, but it's nice to meet you, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. The situation isn't exactly ideal, but it's still kinda fun♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I only wish Yuki were here with us.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm? What is it, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There's someone over there.

rows.Speaker: Ena & Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wh-Who is it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I don't know... But is it just me, or are they getting closer?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, you're from that video...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I am Miku.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Miku? You?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
As in, THE Miku? Hold on.
I guess I can see the resemblance, but are you serious? If that's true, this is huge!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But Miku is a VIRTUAL SINGER, right?
There's no way she could possibly be here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have been waiting for you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You've been waiting? Then you know who we are?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Seriously?
Does that mean you're the one who brought us here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That is half-true. I did call you here.
But there was also another.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Another? Who?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
This place was created from her feelings.
This is her world...her SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What do you mean a place created by her feelings?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Can you try explaining this in a way that actually makes sense?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hold on, if this really is a different world, does that mean we actually got isekai'd?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. SEKAI is a world that is different from the place where you all live.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your world and this one are connected by “Untitled.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “Untitled”? You mean the song file in the shared folder?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And we're here now because we played the file?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No way. So this isn't like a dream or something?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But if this isn't a dream, does that mean the only way to get back to our world is by stopping that song?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We can't exactly do that without our computers.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then what are we supposed to do?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Please...you have to find her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
She cannot continue like this.
If she does not realize her true feelings, then...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
If you find her, you can still save her.
I am sure she will realize her true feelings. And once she does, it will give birth to her song.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um... I still don't quite understand what's going on.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Find some girl so we can save her?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Save...
Miku?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That voice! ...Yuki?
